schemaVersion.description: Version of the report format. Readers check the major; minor versions only add fields and enum values.

version.description: Version of the tool that wrote the report.

commit.description: HEAD commit of the scanned directory, when it is a git repository.

calls.description: Sorted by file, line and column.

title: api-grep report
description: Outbound HTTP and SDK calls found in a codebase by `api-grep scan --json`.

id.description: Stable id: a hash of file, line and column, and of `operation.name` when there is one. Each other request made from the same place (through a wrapper) adds its index.

version.description: Version range from the nearest manifest (package.json, requirements file, pyproject.toml...).

framework.description: Framework helper (n8n, activepieces, ...), when client is framework.

provider.description: Provider id from `api-grep providers` (`stripe`), or `internal` (relative URL, localhost), `env:<NAME>` or `unknown`.

host.description: Host, possibly with placeholders (`{project}.supabase.co`). Absent when unknown.

envName.description: Env var holding the base URL, when hostKind is env.

method.description: HTTP method, upper case; `DYNAMIC` when it is not known statically.

pathTemplate.description: Path with `{name}` placeholders for the dynamic segments.

operationId.description: OpenAPI operation id, from the SDK registry.

operation.description: The operation, for protocols that name it outside the URL; absent when the scan recognizes none.

headerValues.description: Literal header values; null for credentials and dynamic values.

headerAlternatives.description: Headers that can take several values, each with every literal value the code gives (a parameter's default and the arguments its callers pass). `headerValues` holds the first one, or null when some value cannot be read.

bodyFromType.description: TypeScript type the body was read from.

bodyEncoding.description: How the body is encoded: json, form (urlencoded), multipart, raw (bytes or text), xml (an XML document, SOAP envelopes included), or none.

via.description: Wrapper chain the call went through (`wrapper:tlsFetch>doFetch`); the location is the outer call site.

optionsOpaque.description: The request's options are a value the scan could not read as an object literal (a variable, a call): method, headers or body may be missing.

bodySource.description: Where the body shape came from: an object literal in the code, a declared type (TypeScript type, Python or PHP class), a value that could not be read, or no body.

model.description: The model the request names (LLM and other AI APIs); absent when it names none.

clientParts.description: Which of `query` and `headers` the client adds rather than the call (an interceptor, a client default); absent when none.

clientFrom.description: Set when the SDK client is an untyped parameter: where it was found. Absent when the code names the client.

Call.description: One outbound HTTP or SDK call found in the source.

file.description: Path relative to the scanned directory, `/` separated.

Location.description: Where the call is in the source.

Language.description: Source language of a file, from its extension. The TypeScript checker reads typescript, javascript and the inline scripts and forms of html files; the tree-sitter front ends read python, php, and kotlin and java together (one front end, so names resolve across the two).

Client.description: How the request is sent. TypeScript and JavaScript: fetch, axios, got, ky, node-http, jquery ($.ajax, $.get, $.post), xhr (XMLHttpRequest). HTML: html-form (a form submitted to its action URL). Python: requests, httpx, aiohttp, urllib (urllib.request), urllib3. PHP: guzzle, laravel-http (the Http facade), symfony-http (HttpClient), curl, psr-18 (a PSR-7 request sent by any PSR-18 client), php-stream (file_get_contents / fopen on a URL), wordpress (wp_remote_*). Kotlin and Java: okhttp, java-http (java.net.http HttpClient and HttpURLConnection), ktor (Ktor client), spring-rest (RestTemplate, RestClient), spring-webclient (WebClient), feign (an OpenFeign interface method), retrofit (a Retrofit service interface method), apache-httpclient (Apache HttpClient 4 and 5: classic, async and fluent), jaxrs-client (the JAX-RS client: Jersey, RESTEasy), async-http-client (AsyncHttpClient), unirest (Unirest), vertx-webclient (the Vert.x WebClient). Any language: sdk (a registry), framework (a framework helper).

protocol.description: The protocol that names the operation. action: an action-style API that names the operation in a query or form parameter (AWS Query `Action=`, Flickr `method=`).

name.description: The operation: `getTransaction` (JSON-RPC `method`), `GetOrder` (GraphQL; the root fields of an anonymous operation), `Track` (SOAP action), `DescribeInstances` (`Action=`). With `dynamic`, the literal parts with a `{placeholder}` for the rest (`eth_{kind}`); null when no part is known.

fields.description: GraphQL only: the selected field paths from the root, aliases resolved and fragments inlined (`order.id`, `order.customer.email`).

alternatives.description: Every name the call can send when a branch picks one, `name` first.

batch.description: Sent in one request together with other operations (a JSON-RPC array): each operation is a call of its own at the same location.

dynamic.description: Part of the name is not known statically (computed, or a branch the scan could not read).

from.description: Where the request carries the name: a body property or element, a header (`SOAPAction`), a query parameter, or a GraphQL document.

Operation.description: The operation a call performs when its URL does not name it: JSON-RPC, GraphQL, SOAP and action-style APIs send every operation to one URL.

Shape.description: Shape of a value: names and types, never data. `fromType` is the TypeScript type it was read from. Close to JSON Schema, plus `dynamic` and `unknown`.

dynamicKeys.description: Some keys are computed and not listed.

enum.description: Literal values seen in the code.

hint.description: Source identifier the value came from (`email`), used to synthesize examples.

env.description: Environment variable the value is read from; `enum` then holds the default the code gives, if any (`os.getenv("MODEL", "gpt-4o")`).

origin.description: Where the value comes from: a parameter, a call result, an env var, or unknown.
param, call, env, sdk or unknown.

DynamicPart.description: Part of the request the scan could not know statically.

variant.description: minimal: required properties. full: adds optional ones. alt: other enum values, union branches and booleans.

url.description: Concrete URL; an unresolved host stays visible (`https://{baseUrl}/...`).

bodyEncoding.description: How the body is encoded: json, form (urlencoded), multipart, raw (bytes or text), xml (an XML document, SOAP envelopes included), or none.

Example.description: A concrete request synthesized from the call: invented values, stable across runs.

values.description: Model names the code gives, literally or as a default (an environment variable's, a function's returns, every branch of a condition).

env.description: Environment variable the model is read from; `values` holds its default in the code, if any.

envExample.description: The value the repository's example env file nearest the call (`.env.example`, `.env.sample`, …) gives `env`; not a value the code gives.

dynamic.description: Some value could not be read statically (a parameter, a call result): `values` may be incomplete.

hint.description: Identifier the unread value comes from (`get_model`, `settings.model`).

from.description: Where the request carries it: a body property (`model`, `modelId`), a path segment (`/models/{model}`), or an SDK argument that is not the body (`openai("gpt-4o")`).

Model.description: The model a call names, as far as the code tells statically.

name.description: Query parameter name, or header name in lower case, as listed in `query` / `headers`.

from.description: interceptor: an interceptor of the client (OkHttp `addInterceptor`). default: a default the client is built with (Ktor `defaultRequest`, Spring `defaultHeader`).

optional.description: true: added on some requests only (set in a branch or a loop of the interceptor, or after an early return: `if (url.contains(...)) builder.header(...)`). Absent when added to every request.

ClientPart.description: A query parameter or header the client adds to every request it sends, rather than the call itself.

ClientFrom.description: Where the SDK client of a call made on an untyped parameter (`def ask(client, prompt)`, `c: any`) was found. caller: the argument the function's callers in the repository pass, one call per distinct client. manifest: no caller passes a known client, and exactly one SDK the manifests declare has that method.

filesSeen.description: Source files in scope. Test files, mocks, declarations and build output are out of scope.

skipped.description: Files left out. Above 200, files left out by --exclude / --include are only counted in `skippedCounts`.

languages.description: Files seen and scanned per language, for the languages with files in scope.

complete.description: False when something was lost that was not asked for: an unreadable file, a dropped call or a call not followed.

Diagnostics.description: What the scan could not read, so a partial report never looks complete.

file.description: Path relative to the scanned directory.

reason.description: parse-error / internal-error: the file could not be read. excluded / not-included: left out by --exclude / --include.

detail.description: First line of the error, when there is one.

SkippedFile.description: A source file in scope that was not scanned.

reason.description: schema-invalid: the call did not fit this schema. internal-error: the resolver threw.

detail.description: For schema-invalid, the failing property path and message.

DroppedCall.description: A call that was found but left out of `calls`.

reason.description: injected-fetch: a fetch function received from outside (`this.fetchFn(url)`). injected-client: an HTTP client object received without a type that names it (`self.session.post(url)`). wrapper-depth: a call site more than four wrappers away from its HTTP call. receiver-unknown: an SDK method called on an untyped parameter (`client.messages.create(...)`) that no caller in the repository passes a known client to, and that several or none of the SDKs the manifests declare have.

expr.description: The callee expression, for injected-fetch, injected-client and receiver-unknown.

UnfollowedCall.description: A call site the scan saw but could not follow to a request.

Coverage.description: API SDKs the repository declares or imports. Absent for --changed-since scans.

package.description: Package name in its ecosystem: an npm package, a PyPI distribution, a Composer package, a Maven `group:artifact`.

provider.description: Provider id the package talks to.

supported.description: An SDK registry exists for the package, so its calls can be listed.

declared.description: Declared in a manifest the scan covered: `dependencies` / `peerDependencies` of a package.json, a requirements file, pyproject.toml, Pipfile, setup.cfg or setup.py, `require` of a composer.json, the dependencies of a Gradle build script (test configurations aside) or of a pom.xml (test scope aside).

importSites.description: Scanned files that import the package (type-only imports aside).

calls.description: Calls in `calls` made through this package.

status.description: ok: supported and calls found. unsupported: imported, no registry (its calls are missed). imported-no-calls: supported but no call found (a wrapper, or a detection bug). declared-not-imported: likely unused.

SdkCoverage.description: An API SDK the repository uses, compared with the calls found through it.

Ecosystem.description: Package registry of an SDK: npm (package.json), pypi (requirements files, pyproject.toml, Pipfile, setup.cfg / setup.py), composer (composer.json), maven (`group:artifact` coordinates from Gradle build scripts, Gradle version catalogs and pom.xml).
